evidence.observation: The homepage immediately presents Jamie as the actor who turns ambiguous, high-context work into requirements, workflows, documentation, public-facing tools, and durable handoffs, with direct paths to role-fit work, resume, and contact.
The page maps concrete operating practices to named projects and explains Jamie's fit for technical operations, product operations, implementation, documentation, coordination, and delivery work.

The two new citations strengthen the public case by separately supporting founding-member attribution and Jamie's documented 2017 fire-code study groups and repeal advocacy. They do not claim sole leadership, legislative authorship, Office of Nightlife causality, or sole responsibility for policy outcomes.

Both new claims resolve through canonical occurrences to NPR and Gothamist records with visible source notes and explicit does-not-establish boundaries. The NPR name variant is preserved in the source boundary rather than silently treated as exact corroboration.

The chronology split is narrower and more accurate than the baseline's undifferentiated 2024-Present label: NYC Artist Coalition is identified from 2017, while the later CRS collaboration is separately dated from 2024. The split does not extend the 30+ page campaign-memory claim or turn 2017 advocacy into causality for later CRS work.

CallNYC remains an independent, archived, unofficial follow-on to the first CouncilStat hackathon; the page avoids official-service, formal-submission, winner, and broader hackathon-superlative claims.

The 2x revenue statement remains contribution language and withholds dashboards, revenue breakdowns, customer data, and internal operating details, preserving the approved causal and confidentiality boundary.
The page distinguishes a documented $490,539 public funding recommendation from final funding and does not expose private financial, legal, property, or stakeholder material.

The HTML resume and approved PDF reinforce the same target role, operating-structure throughline, collective NYC Artist Coalition framing, careful HJE contribution claim, and corrected 2016 CouncilStat chronology. The phone number remains confined to the approved PDF.
The case study is release-capable and materially clearer than the baseline, but repeated explanations of public/private boundaries and collective-work limits still lengthen the reading path.

Jamie is visible through specific documentation, web-infrastructure, study-group, translation, and coordination work while policy outcomes remain collective. Some repeated boundary prose keeps the page strong rather than exceptional.

Project cards and case studies still rely primarily on text and representative artifact descriptions rather than approved visual artifacts. This is unchanged from the accepted baseline and is explicitly allowed as the application-stage visual-evidence deferral.

All eight declared routes returned 200 without desktop, mobile, or 200%-equivalent reflow overflow; 24 of 24 traversed controls showed visible focus, including nine citation controls. Evidence is strong and release-capable, though it remains local staging evidence rather than deployed production verification.

Canonical metadata, Open Graph title and image, Twitter card, resume download, and contact paths are present and trustworthy. The evidence uses staging metadata defaults, so production sharing remains unverified.

The exact candidate and contract fingerprints verify, deterministic repository, public-safety, claim-integrity, resume, route, application-path, and responsive gates pass, but production smoke, deployed-commit, indexing, monitoring, rollback, and human approval remain outside application-ready scope.

The candidate removes unexplained OTI and internal proof-surface, hiring-manager, claim-safety, approval, and pending-approval narration without weakening protected boundaries; reader effort remains at the baseline score rather than regressing.
